:::

```{=html}
<div class="post-toolbar" role="group" aria-label="Post actions">
  <button type="button" class="post-toolbar__btn" data-action="print" onclick="window.print()" title="Print">
    <i class="bi bi-printer" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Print</span>
  </button>
  <a class="post-toolbar__btn" data-action="pdf" id="pdf-download-btn" href="index.pdf" download title="Download as PDF">
    <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Download</span>
  </a>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  // Derive the PDF filename from the post slug (the containing folder name in the URL).
  var btn = document.getElementById('pdf-download-btn');
  if (!btn) return;
  var parts = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '').split('/');
  var slug = parts[parts.length - 1];
  if (slug && slug !== 'posts') {
    btn.href = slug + '.pdf';
    btn.download = slug + '.pdf';
  }
})();
</script>
```
